title: NAMCS Health Center visits with post-COVID-19 condition (ICD-10-CM U09.9) listed, 2024
unit: weighted visits to community health centers
definition: Visit records with post-COVID-19 condition (ICD-10-CM U09.9) in any of the 30 diagnosis fields.
method: Sum of VISWT over visits with a diagnosis starting U099; 169 sampled visits.
comparability: Community health centers only: not all outpatient care in the United States.
Counts visits, not people, and not dollars; one person can appear in several visits.
Diagnoses are truncated to 4 characters in the public file.
No design variable for standard errors is released, so no confidence interval is given.
summary: 2024: about 43,343 weighted health-center visits listed post-COVID-19 condition (ICD-10-CM U09.9) (169 sampled visits; meets the 30-record reliability floor).
how_to_use: Context or cross-check for a document that reports health-center or outpatient visit counts; never a national prevalence or a cost.

provenance.collection_note: Diagnoses recorded for a national sample of visits to community health centers; visits, not people.
provenance.computed_by: Computed in code from the federal file; no AI model
provenance.relevance: Community health centers only: not all outpatient care in the United States.
provenance.reliability: 169 sampled visits; meets the 30-record reliability floor.
